lines: Villain! Be rendered to dust by my Demon Sword: Sakura Blossom!!
Wielding her long blade with ease, Lena came after the three of us.
I never thought we'd be attacked by the sword that had saved us in Yomihara.
There's no use arguing about it!!
Each time the blade grazed the tips of our noses, a breeze carrying a flowery scent swirled by.
H-Hey!? This girl is strong! What are we gonna do, Fuma!? Don't you have some kind of plan?
To begin with, this was just a misunderstanding, so there was essentially no reason for us to be fighting.
(She doesn't seem like a bad person, so if only we could calm her down and get her to listen to us...)
Even while I was thinking about that, the Devildom Knight's attacks were whizzing past my hair.
Anyway, if we don't stop her in her tracks, our heads are gonna be flying! Hebiko!
As expected of Hebiko, she already knew what I had planned and squirted octopus ink as hard as she could.
(Even a Devildom Knight can't brandish her sword without her vision!)
Soon, everything around us turned black―
Demon Sword: Sakura Blossom... Sakura Screen!!!!
Lena unleashed her Demon Sword: Sakura Blossom with a flash, and a whirlwind rose from the ground.
The cloud of dust that had been blown into the air soon took on the form of cherry blossom petals and scattered Hebiko's octopus ink all about.
Amazing... it's like a flower storm.
The octopus ink smokescreen was blown away by the wind or absorbed by the petals, and within moments it became completely ineffective.
It would appear to be my victory. Kidnappers, prepare yourselves!!!
Lena's sword was closing in on my forehead.
Hmm, hmm...? That guy helped... ehh!? Wait, wait, waiiiiit～～!!!
Minasaki's sudden outcry made the magical blade, which had truly been about to cut my head in half, stop just short of my eyebrows.
When I looked in their direction, still frozen in place, the Yatagarasu child was gesturing frantically.
Hmhm, you were about to be sold to a pet store by Orc slave twaders?
And these guys saved you? And gave you snacks?
What's this!? So this young man has been falsely accused...!?
That's what I've been trying to tell you the whole time.
Lena opened her already wide eyes even wider and suddenly withdrew her sword.
Oh my, oh my, you should have told me sooner! Just a bit more and I would have taken your head off... oh my, oh my...
Devildom Knight Lena had finally come to her senses and, almost like a different person from before, bowed her head to me in apology.
Sheesh, don't cut people's heads off over a misunderstanding...
As long as she gets it now!
Yeah, you already have the scratch on your forehead from the cat, Fuma-chan, so it's all the same if you get one or two more cuts!
It's definitely not all the same!
And behind us, a little critter was trying to stealthily tiptoe away.
Don't tell me you're trying to run away after nearly getting us killed!
Minasaki, who, as always, was only quick when it came to running away, turned her back on us and dashed down the alley.
Hey!!! Damn it... I won't forgive that little critter...
Anyway, the misunderstanding had been cleared up. We said our goodbyes to Lena and started to head home.
(But those Devildom Knights... what a truly terrifying enemy if you have to fight them...)
"Devildom Knight." There were many different knights in the Devildom, but only a handful had earned that title.
(Whether then or now, what is a Devildom Knight doing in this corner of the human world...)
I was interested in that, but for now getting home was more important. I left, sure that we would meet again sooner or later.
Tokiko and Sakura welcomed me as I somehow managed to make it home that day.
You're late! I already ate your dinner, Fuma-kun!
There were a lot of things to deal with.
I see. By the way, um, who might this be...?
Tokiko kept looking behind me. And when I turned around to see what was there―
